Container.Name: nexora-backend
Container.Overview: The API service of Nexora, a self-hosted wiki with nested pages, backlinks, full text search and versions. Needs a PostgreSQL database (16 or newer) and the nexora-frontend container in the same Docker network. Has no web interface of its own.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Connection string of your PostgreSQL database, e.g. postgres://nexora:PASSWORD@192.168.1.10:5432/nexora?sslmode=disable

Config.Name: JWT secret
Config.Description: Signs the sessions. A long random value: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Port inside the network. Leave at 8080; the frontend expects it there.

Config.Name: Attachments
Config.Description: Where uploaded files are kept. The directory must be writable for uid 10001.
